mobbin:e7700240-0fb3-4a8b-aa81-7a640b1aa.summary: User picks strength/improvement tags (custom allowed, improvement capped at 2), waits for FeedbackAI (~30s skeleton), then chooses one of three AI drafts to insert and edit.
steps: Strengths + Opportunities tags — custom + select up to 2
Tags + Examples fields for selected traits
FeedbackAI loading — up to 30s + skeleton bars
Choose suggestion — 3 AI drafts, Generate new
Suggestion list — drafts include custom-tag phrasing
Suggestion selected — green check, ready for Next
steal: Tag inputs with 'select up to 2' on opportunities (steps 1–2) — constrains AI prompt before generation.
Loading copy 'up to 30 seconds' + skeleton bars (step 3) — sets AI latency expectation.
Choose among 3 suggestions + Generate new (steps 4–6) — human picks tone before edit.
GPT-3 disclosure under the card (steps 3–6) — AI provenance on formative text.
avoid: AI drafts echo whimsical custom tags ('good potato') into the narrative (steps 5–6) — sanitize/ground clinical competency language.
mobbin:e7700240-0fb3-4a8b-aa81-7a640b1aa.fit: AI formative draft for faculty after competency tags — extends Responses/Skill Development; not accreditation assembly.

mobbin:560e3cdd-be36-4bf6-a0f1-8ca6fe968.summary: From 360 Open Reviews, user starts an anonymous peer review, selects adjectives per competency, generates FeedbackAI narrative, reviews the multi-section draft, submits, then sees progress (1 of 2) on the dashboard.
steps: 360 Open Reviews — Give Peer Review + progress bar
Anonymous Reviews — How it works + Let's do this
Questionnaire — adjective chips + Generate Feedback
Tags selected (helpful, team player)
AI narrative filled in rich-text editor
More competency sections collapsed — Saved draft
Review & Submit — tags + narratives per competency
Review & Submit footer — Back + Submit
Success modal — Nice work + Shared successfully
Dashboard — 1 of 2 reviews submitted progress
steal: How-it-works: adjectives → FeedbackAI, then AI summarizes peers anonymously (step 2) — privacy + AI role stated upfront.
Generate Feedback from selected adjectives, then edit with 'sprinkle in specific examples' (steps 3–5).
Review & Submit aggregates competency tags + narratives before Submit (steps 7–8).
Initiator progress '1 of 2 reviews submitted' bar after send (steps 1, 10).
avoid: Emoji/GIF toolbar on evaluation narrative (steps 5–6) — too casual for clinical summative reports.
mobbin:560e3cdd-be36-4bf6-a0f1-8ca6fe968.fit: Peer/faculty formative AI write-up over competency chips; anonymity aggregate maps to multi-rater skill reports, not utilisation KPIs.

mobbin:f2d6fb5a-36ee-4c5c-9612-55be9bbd3.summary: User selects an AI suggestion, edits the feedback text, submits, then lands on Feedback & Kudos where the entry shows 'Jon hasn't seen this yet' with Edit/Delete.
steps: Choose AI suggestion — one selected
Edit and send — editable draft + Submit Feedback
1:1 Feedback & Kudos — unseen feedback card
Feed — unseen status + Edit/Delete/Comment
steal: Edit-after-select before Submit (steps 1–2) — AI draft never auto-sends.
'hasn't seen this yet' status on the shared card (steps 3–4) — delivery state for formative notes.
Edit/Delete retained while unseen (steps 3–4) — revoke before learner opens.
mobbin:f2d6fb5a-36ee-4c5c-9612-55be9bbd3.fit: Post-AI faculty note with held visibility — useful for formative learner reports before dean PDF sharing.
